experiments.title: Conway · Game of Life
experiments.description: A classic implementation of Conway's Game of Life with configurable rules (B3/S23 by default).

experiments.title: HexaLife · Game of Life
experiments.description: A less classic hexagonal Game of Life. Rules such as B2/S34 and B2/S35 keep some stability.

experiments.title: Quine Counter
experiments.description: A quine incrementing a counter displayed inside its own source code.

experiments.title: Log-Shaped Quine
experiments.description: A quine shaped as 'LOG', using only variables named log.

experiments.title: Polyglot Quine
experiments.description: Two polyglot partial quines in the same file. Run with `node polyglot-quine.js.py ; python3 polyglot-quine.js.py`.

experiments.title: Thomas Aquinas
experiments.description: An animated quine scrolling the Prima Via from Thomas Aquinas's Summa Theologica.

experiments.title: First Quine · 256B
experiments.description: My first quine golfed down to exactly 256 bytes.

experiments.title: Glitch Mosaic
experiments.description: A mosaic of genuinely glitched images, each one broken with a different technique.

experiments.title: ASCII Loader
experiments.description: A six-frame loading spinner drawn as a FIGlet font: each digit 0-5 is a frame of the animation.

experiments.title: Mandelbrot
experiments.description: The Mandelbrot set with hand-tuned iteration colouring.

experiments.title: Meta Glyph Depth
experiments.description: A hand-drawn FIGlet face whose letters are built out of the very ASCII characters they are made to print.

experiments.title: True is False
experiments.description: Four lines of look-alike Unicode identifiers that quietly redefine true.

experiments.title: Var-Shaped Quine
experiments.description: A quine shaped as 'VAR', using only variables named var.

experiments.title: First Quine · v1
experiments.description: My first readable JavaScript quine: an array of lines that reprints itself. Where it all started.

experiments.title: First Quine · v2
experiments.description: A denser second pass: destructuring, slices, and printf formatting let it reproduce itself in fewer lines.

experiments.title: Quine Checker
experiments.description: A Node tool: runs a file and verifies it reproduces its own source exactly. The judge of quines.

experiments.title: Quine-Checker Quine
experiments.description: An ongoing challenge: a quine that checks whether a program is a quine. Still a stub — work in progress.
